description.p: Soplos Store finds, installs, updates and removes applications from APT, Flatpak and Snap in one place. Featured apps, popular apps and categories come from public databases (Debian AppStream, Flathub and the Snap Store), with ratings from ODRS, and an app available from several sources appears once with a choice of where to install it.
It also shows a tray icon when updates are available, and it opens .deb, .flatpak, .flatpakref, .snap and .AppImage files.

description.p: First release of Soplos Store, built with Tauri 2, a Rust backend and a Svelte frontend.
Firmware updates through fwupd, subcategories, a fuller app page and a systemd timer for the update checks.
